mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET reservation_no = #{reservationNo}, user_id = #{userId}, hotel_id = #{hotelId}, room_type_id = #{roomTypeId}, check_in_date = #{checkInDate}, check_out_date = #{checkOutDate}, guest_name = #{guestName}, guest_phone = #{guestPhone}, guest_count = #{guestCount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.reservation_no, h.name AS hotel_name, r.room_type_id, rt.name AS room_type_name, rm.room_number AS assigned_room_number, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.guest_name, r.guest_count, r.total_amount, r.status, r.create_time FROM reservation r JOIN hotel h ON h.id = r.hotel_id JOIN room_type rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id LEFT JOIN room rm ON rm.id = r.assigned_room_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.reservation_no, h.name AS hotel_name, rt.name AS room_type_name, rm.room_number AS assigned_room_number, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.guest_name, r.guest_phone, r.guest_count, r.total_amount, r.status, r.actual_check_in_time, r.actual_check_out_time, r.create_time FROM reservation r JOIN hotel h ON h.id = r.hotel_id JOIN room_type rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id LEFT JOIN room rm ON rm.id = r.assigned_room_id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId}
WHERE r.check_in_date = #{arrivalDate} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY r.create_time
WHERE r.check_out_date = #{departureDate} AND r.status = 'CHECKED_IN' ORDER BY r.create_time
